content: Envelope adoption on a living workflow (fabro-8eda, run 01M1EGK6J8): context_allow_keys declarations and prompt outcome contracts are ONE unit — when a prompt's context_updates JSON changes (new required key), the node's context_allow_keys in workflow.fabro must change in the same commit, or the envelope drops the key with a visible notice (observed: seed fabro-f831 added lesson_capture to implementer.md; the graph still declared implementation_summary,journal; deliverable half-dead until 0420185d0). Before declaring allow-keys, read the CURRENT prompt outcome JSON blocks, not the last-known contract. Read side: preamble_allow_keys should name exactly the keys the prompt's Input section names — determinism is the goal, size is not (13k evidence-dominated preamble is fine at 1.9% window use).

name: deterministic-run-scope-gate
description: a9bb step 2 landed (cycle 1): scripts/qualitygate.nu check-run-scope — run branches (fabro/run/*) may not touch .fabro/workflows/; world base derived DYNAMICALLY (local non-run branches + origin remotes, newest merge-base by %cI), probe via complete+exit_code, FAILS CLOSED when no base resolves; covers committed (diff base..worktree), staged, and untracked (git status --porcelain) touches; .fabro/journal/ and .seeds/ deliberately exempt. Paired with the fs_hide/fs_write adoption (planner: hide+read-only, implementer: hide, reviewer: read-only capability) the agents-behind-with-workflow-files failure mode is now mechanically blocked at three layers: node scope, gate, platform-PR flow.
